spans.s:
m. (-मः)
A horse of a dark colour.
n. (-मं)
Gold.
f. (-मा)
1 An Apsaras or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven.
2 A handsome woman.
E.
हि to go, मक् aff.

m. (-लः)
Coral.
E.
हेम gold, and कन्दस्न a shoot.

m. (-रः)
A goldsmith.
E.
हेमन् gold, and कार who makes or works; also हेमकर्त्तृ (-र्त्ता,) &c.

m. (-टः)
One of the ranges of mountains dividing the known continent into nine Varṣas; this range is the second south of Ilāvṛta, or the central division, and is immediately to the north of the Himālaya, forming with it the boundaries of the Kinnara Varṣam.
E.
हेम gold or golden, and कूट a peak.

m. (-लिः)
Fire.
E.
हेम gold, and केलि who sports.

m. (-शः)
ŚIVA.
E.
हेम gold, and केश् hair.

f. (-री)
A medicinal sort of moon-plant.
E.
हेम gold, and क्षीरी a name of several plants.

f. (-नी)
Reṇuka, a perfume.
E.
हेम golden, and गन्धिनी a perfume.

m. (-लः)
Fire.
E.
हेम gold, and ज्वाला flame.

m. (-रुः)
Datura or thorn-apple.
E.
हेम, and तरु tree.

n. (-रं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
हेम gold, तृ to pass, aff. घञ्.

m. (-ग्धः)
The glomerous fig tree.
f. (-ग्धी)
A medicinal sort of moon-plant.
E.
हेम gold, टुग्ध milk; also with कन् added, हेमटुग्धक.

m. (-कः)
The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata): see the last.

n. (-म)
Gold.
m. (-मा)
1 The planet

MERCURY.
2

Winter.
E.
हि to go, मनिन् aff.

mn. (-न्तः-न्तं)
The cold season, winter, the two months, Agrahāyaṇa and Pauṣa, or about November-December.
E.
हन to hurt, भच् Uṇādi aff., हि substituted for the root, and मुट् augment.

m. (-थः)
Elephant or wood-apple.
E.
हेमन्त winter, and नाथ lord.

m. (-तः)
The mountain Meru.
E.
हेम gold, and पर्व्वत mountain.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.)
2 The China rose, the flower.
m. (-ष्पः)
1 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.)
2 The Lodh tree.
f. (-ष्पी)
Bengal madder.
E.
हेम golden, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-कः)
The Champaka.
f. (-ष्पिका)
Yellow jasmine.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ला)
The wife of YAMA.
E.
हेम gold, and माला a garland.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Full of gold and gems.
E.
हेम, and रत्न a gem, मयट् aff.

f. (-णी)
Turmeric.
E.
हेम gold, राग colour, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-लः)
1 A goldsmith.
2 A chameleon, a lizard.
3 A touchstone.
E.
हेम gold, ला to have or take, aff. क.

n. (-लं)
A pearl.
E.
हेम gold, वल surrounding.

m. (-ङ्खः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
हेम gold, and शङ्ख a shell.

f. (-खा)
A medicinal sort of moon-plant.
E.
हेम gold, and शिखा crest.

n. (-कं)
A necklace.
E.
हेम gold, सूत्र a string, कन् added.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 GARUḌ

A lion.
3 The mountain

Sumeru.
4

BRAHMĀ.
5

The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
हेम gold, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-द्रिः)
The mountain Meru.
E.
हेम gold, and अद्रि a mountain.
